title: Nostr Keys
description: Understand and manage your Nostr identity keys (nsec/npub)

steps.title: Key Pair Basics
steps.description: Nostr uses a private key (nsec) for signing and a public key (npub) for identification. Never share your nsec!

steps.title: View Your Keys
steps.description: Go to Settings → Network → Identity to see your npub and manage keys

steps.title: Key Formats
steps.description: nsec = bech32 encoded private key (starts with nsec1...) | npub = bech32 encoded public key (starts with npub1...) | hex = raw 64-char hex string

steps.title: Backup Your Keys
steps.description: Export your nsec to a secure location. Use a password manager. Losing keys = losing your identity.

steps.title: Export Keys
steps.description: Click 'Export Keys' and save the JSON file securely

steps.title: Key Rotation
steps.description: If compromised, generate new keys and update your profile. Old events remain verifiable but new ones use new keys.
